# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Barbarian level 9 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human
# Barbarian level-1..level-8 martial chassis baseline to level 9 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from the level-1 through level-8
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. No
# rage-power choice-slot line is present (rage powers are a
# level-2/4/6/8/... choice-list feature this tranche deliberately does not
# implement — a genuinely open-ended power list, not a flat arithmetic
# burden — and level 9 is not a rage-power level anyway), so no new choice=
# line is required beyond the level-1..level-8 baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Barbarian burden surface: no rage
# execution (activation, round tracking, fatigue), no rage-power
# recognition or execution, no damage-reduction application engine, and no
# level-10+ progression. The PF1 Core Rulebook Barbarian class table's
# level-9 "Special" column reads "Trap sense +3" (verified independently
# against d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com) — a tier-rise on the
# already-grounded Trap Sense formula pillar (level / 3), not a new class
# feature, so no new pillar is grounded at level 9 — only the existing
# pillars are widened.

race_id=race:human
class_level=class:barbarian:9
ability=strength:16

ability=charisma:8

skill=skill:survival:1
